clauses.clause: Health bars: Alphas and infected zoo animals show the world-space bar (damaged or ≤ 15 m); dead ones show none; normal animals none.
clauses.note: I inspected all20 full-size native Metal captures. Alpha, lion, gorilla, elephant, zebra and flamingo show six full bars nearby, no bars while far/full-health, and six half bars while far/damaged. Native lethal damage leaves all six at0HP with no bar during falling corpse poses. All five healthy zoo species show none. Pixel fills are512/full and256/half; the actual far-healthy frames have0 red pixels in each former bar region.

evidence.what: All20 full-size captures inspected. Every species/state/backend/quality matches the criterion; previous near-bar pixel regions reject the actual far-healthy missing bars as a negative control.
